_comment: Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Fusion HCM Candidate Experience) tenants read by sources/oracle-orc.mjs. One entry per career site: name (short key), host (the *.oraclecloud.com REST host), site (SiteNumber, e.g. CX_1001), company (display name). Optional: siteUrlName (SiteURLName used in public job URLs when it differs from SiteNumber), urlBase (custom careers domain, default https://{host}/hcmUI/CandidateExperience), country (facet typeahead term, default Australia), dream (true = keep every job in the country, not just the hunt location), enabled:false to skip. Find host/site by opening the careers site and reading the /hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions request in DevTools. Tested 2026-09-12 and NOT on ORC: your current employer AU (SmartRecruiters); Fortescue, South32, Northern Star, Synergy, Western Power (SuccessFactors); Mineral Resources, UWA, Kinetic IT (PageUp); Alcoa, Bankwest, HBF, RAC WA, Bunnings, Telstra (Workday); Newmont, Ventia (Phenom); Water Corporation (LiveHire); Main Roads WA (jobs.wa.gov.au). Woodside, Perth Airport, Horizon Power block scripted fetches (403); Curtin careers URL not found. Stantec (hdhl.fa.us6) and ATCO (eezy.fa.ca2) tenants exist but list no Australian jobs; the 'PWC Careers' tenant (fa-etuc) is Public Works Commission NC, not PwC.
